DESIGN-07.evidence: Gatekeeper re-gate on 2026-10-26 at HEAD a2080b9, against the first gate (games/stormcatch/gates/design-01.json, reviewed at 7ba264c). catalog.md is now v2 (T-0018, md5 cfdbab13a238b15a964cabceaefc2b9d; v1 was 93bec4e55b23bcac86505bdfbc26dfc0). I re-verified each part of design-01.json's 'needed'. (a) The basis is adopted. Section 1 rule 8 and section 3.8 state the sheet v2 basis for Coin Pouch, Starter Pack, Coin Crate and Coin Chest. Section 3.8's 'Counted' list (Rod, companions, the bonus category, New Tide, the Lure and owned luck passes) matches sheet section 19.2's word for word. Its 'Not counted' list is timed boosts, friends and the 2x Coins pass, the same exclusions as sheet sections 3.1 and 19.2 and GDD v3.1 section 5. Section 3.6 puts Tide Pots on the same basis. (b) The copy is changed. Section 3.8 and the section 8 coin-packs row read 'About N coins (about M minutes of fishing)'. The section 9 descriptions and the Products.luau proposal read 'Coins worth about M minutes of fishing'. check.luau now enforces 'of fishing' and forbids 'your current'. (c) The figures are re-cited. Section 3.2, the section 4 table and the section 5 2x Coins row give 1.31x / 2.34x / 2.87x and a heavy spender at 3.01x. Section 3.4 and the section 5 Lucky Bobber row give Lure 7 at minute 23.7. Section 3.4 gives x5.63 (5.625, rounded half up as sheet section 10 prints it). Every figure appears in sheet v2 (sections 1, 10 and 19.1, lines 53-78 and 631-654). A grep for the stale values ('your fishing', '23.9', '5.62', '2.6-3.7', '3.7x', 'watch W1', 'current catch rate', 'your current', 'payers 2-4x') finds them only in the changelog and in the notes that explain the change (lines 15-17, 277, 385). (d) W1 and W2 are replaced. The three Sky Bell rows now read plain 'Pass'. A new 'Watch items W1 and W2: closed by GDD v3' block replaces the 'only Showers' sentence with GDD v3 section 4.2 rule 8. Its numbers match the sources: 0 of 168 hours missing a visit, 672 cycles with the 180 s window and 260 s longest rain wait (my first-gate re-run of cove_visits_check.py); 17.8 h and 22.9 h for the rarest marks, and 10.8 min and 15.8 min for the first bridge and set (sheet section 19.5). (e) The fairness table still passes 15 of 15. I counted 15 product rows, each ending '**Pass**'. The revised cells cite sheet v2 and GDD v3. The rest still holds: every item has a vault motivation and a price tier (sections 2 and 4), and the ladder and prices are unchanged. Catalog sections 6-7 (the D2 handling, the D6 disclosure options and E-0001) are byte-unchanged, and E-0001 is still open. Model re-run: `python3 games/stormcatch/docs/models/catalog_numbers.py --out <scratchpad>` exited 0 and wrote 82 lines, md5 b719ac215b59a24234024cb54a9d4614, byte-identical to the stored output. Its section [A] still reproduces sheet section 13. Config proposal, checked read-only with the project's pinned tools: `lune run .../catalog-config/check` printed 'All catalog config checks passed.' (115 ok lines); stylua --check, luau-lsp analyze (strict) and `git apply --check` of Products.diff all exited 0. Only descriptions and comments changed; every grant, flag and effect is unchanged. The 'needed' entry also asked that the catalog, the sheet and the GDD state one basis. On the point that failed the first gate, the 2x Coins pass, all three now agree, and the catalog's list equals the sheet's. Two remaining wording gaps, both non-blocking. I propose them as design-followups.md items 14 and 15; the Director owns that file. Item 14: GDD v3.1 section 5's 'counts' list leaves out 'the Lure', and section 4.8 leaves out the Lure and owned luck passes. Both cite sheet sections 3.1 and 19.2, and the GDD's own rule says the sheet wins. This text was already there at the first gate, and I missed it then. Item 15: catalog section 3.8 and catalog_numbers [G] say two players with the same progress get the same coins 'whatever else they bought'. The sheet's basis counts owned luck passes, so a Lucky Bobber owner's grant is larger. Computed with catalog_numbers.py's own functions in Pebble Cove Clear water, coins per catch rise +5.3% (luck x1.00 -> x1.25), +6.0% (x1.28 -> x1.60) and +7.7% (x3.00 -> x3.75). So 'Robux never compounds on Robux' (sheet 19.2, GDD section 5, catalog 3.2) holds for the 2x Coins pass but not strictly for the bobber. This does not fail the fairness table for three reasons. The pre-purchase panel shows the exact coin amount N. The in-game copy says 'Boosts and 2x Coins do not change the amount', which is true in the catalog's terms, where a boost is a timed item. And 5-8% sits within 'about'. The Economist decides whether owned luck passes stay in the basis. The Monetization Designer and the Designer then align the wording.
